title: Endothelial Cell Photography
item_service_description: <p>  Endothelial cell photography involves the use of a specular microscope to determine the endothelial cell count. It is used by ophthalmologists as a predictor of success of ocular surgery or certain other ocular procedures.</p>
revision_history: <p>  08/1992 -&#160;Stipulated that endothelial cell photography subject to the limitation on coverage of visual tests prior to cataract surgery. Effective date 08/31/1992. (TN 61)&#160;</p>
